tools.name: mcp.setup
tools.description: Write the loopback MCP unit. Does not start a standing server.

tools.name: mcp.check
tools.description: Check the mcp unit recorded by mcp.setup.

tools.name: mcp.uninstall
tools.description: Delete the mcp folder under the self-hosted home. That folder holds the install, config, and state mcp.setup wrote.
